'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Sam Marlow LS Coruscant: Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sam Marlow]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Coruscant: Night Club (Virtual Block 5)|Coruscant: Night Club]]
* '''Username:''' Hari Seldon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
